flow: AnyNativeNameForm Save invokes commit(value); only UTF8 length >4096 or NUL disables Save. No text-equality no-op or normalization.
finishNaming retains title in the original owned pendingNameSubmission. Dismissal consumes it once, preserves lifetime/canWrite checks, and passes title unchanged to model.rename.

AnyLibraryPresentation.rename performs the existing pending/ownership checks; calls hierarchyPresentation.rename and then original repository.rename(expectedTitle:item.title,newTitle:title) under session/lease/authorization.
AnyHierarchyPresentationState.rename assigns names[objectID]=title unconditionally. Its receive path replaces the snapshot without a title comparison.

The production change is only the four original String comparisons inside repository.rename. Original queue, current membership, version/apply-sequence fence, authorization, patch, catch/rethrow and read order remain byte-identical.
